$schema: inventory of the Golfballs.com Chrome extension — source of truth for all documentation generation

extension.name: Golfballs.com
extension.description: Helper utilities for the golfballs.com website — a CRM/sales productivity toolkit injected into golfballs.com admin pages and admin.icustomize.com iframes.

extensionPages.name: Extension Popup
extensionPages.purpose: Primary launcher: pick an email template for the current CRM page, see resolved variables stream in, and reach Charge, Order Edit, Watch/Watch List, My Tasks, CRM Search, admin Notifications, and Submit Proof.
mainSections: Action stack (Charge / Order Edit / Watch + Watch List / My Tasks / CRM Search / admin Notifications / Submit Proof)

extensionPages.name: Template Editor & Settings
extensionPages.entryPoint: editor.html (popup window opened via background 'openEditor' message; sidebar tabs: order/case/account/note/task/call_log + Settings)
extensionPages.purpose: Author email templates (rich text + variables + rules), note/task/call-log templates, and configure the whole extension via the Settings panel.
mainSections: Settings panel (theme, scales, features, shortcuts, custom pages, dev settings, presets)

extensionPages.name: Code Sandbox (hidden)
extensionPages.purpose: The only context allowed to eval user code — evaluates 'code variables' for templates and campaign conditions via postMessage.

modals.purpose: Keyboard-first CRM task creator with templates, category, priority and relative due dates.
Searchable, filterable view of the rep's CRM task list with bulk select, open-tabs, and campaign launch.
Instant search of contacts/accounts/orders via CRM Solr; filter chips, saved queries, bulk selection for campaigns.
modals.dataSource: POST SolrIndexCrm.asmx/Query + worker-owned encrypted IndexedDB gb-crm-index-secure

modals.purpose: Advanced grouped AND/OR condition builder that compiles to Solr syntax; save/load named queries.
Keyboard-first call logger: template filter bar, '/' composer (category, direction, voicemail, subject, note), live preview, submit to CRM activity log.
Personal cross-session to-do/watch list with priorities, due dates, completion, and links back to the order/contact each item came from.
Cost/price/margin/markup/profit calculator with animated totals and a minimum-margin warning.
Click-to-open full email threads from Case Email History, with auto case-categorization chips and a recommended reply template.
Preview of case notes / SMS / chat transcripts with recommended reply template.
openedBy: injected preview button on text/note rows

modals.purpose: Zoom/pan viewer for customer logo art with multi-source resolution (render overlay, express upload, CDN), color extraction, download, Submit Proof and 3D ball preview.
openedBy: hover-expand button injected on order images

modals.purpose: Recolor a logo (source→target color swap) and render it on a 3D ball on a grass scene for client-ready mockups.
Three.js 3D preview of golf balls, poker chips, divot tools, markers, tees and assembled gift-box sets with decal projection (logo, personalized text, monogram; dual-pole).
openedBy: embedded in GiftCatalog / Mockup Composer / proposal renders

modals.purpose: Browse/search the entire golfballs.com catalog (Solr full index), filter by category/brand/price, customize items (logo/text/monogram, gift sets), and build a quote/proposal.
Accept customer artwork first, then resolve YAML-defined product options such as scene and color to exact source images for durable AI mockup batches.
modals.backend: RevStack product-generation studio, public managed-reference endpoint, YAML catalog, reference-asset cache, and batch endpoints
modals.notes: Products can expose generic ordered option groups whose combinations map to exact source images. Venture Towel registers Scene and Color groups; aspect ratio remains built in, and the customer logo is the only user-supplied generation input.

modals.purpose: Per-product option selection: imprint type (logo/text/monogram), colors, dual-pole second imprint, gift-set packaging upsell with live 3D preview, quantity/price ladder.

Compose and send an HTML proposal email with line items, pricing, discounts/free promo lines, 3D render snapshots, and cart link; tracks the proposal server-side (CreateProposalEmail + TrackProposal + Opportunity update).
Bulk-email selected rows from Task List or CRM Search: pick a template, preview, then watch per-recipient progress with retry.
openedBy: 'Run Campaign' with rows selected in TaskList/CRMSearch
modals.backend: local EmailRunner orchestration using validated fetchRaw and paAutomate worker calls

modals.purpose: Define multi-step outreach campaigns (email / task / call-log / code actions) with grouped AND/OR conditions, audience ordering, pacing + jitter, dry-run simulation, and pause/resume.
openedBy: Run Campaign from selected CRM Search rows
Run Campaign from selected Task List rows

modals.purpose: Pick approval + commitment dates on two mini calendars; saving runs a multi-step ASP.NET postback chain through the admin.icustomize.com iframe with step-by-step progress toasts.
Quick-create a CRM contact: account search/attach, name, email, phone, company.
Submit decoration proof art to the CRM: image, order/customer IDs, item + artist dropdowns (scraped live), notes, and gallery of prior proofs.
Compact inline variant of Quick Task for fast entry.
Admin-build inbox for relayed inbound customer replies with Open/All/Done filters, search, account/email actions, and manual completion.
Preview-only shipping, billing, payment, multi-destination allocation, address-suggestion, and order-summary UI. Place Order generates a mock confirmation and performs no order POST or charge.
openedBy: Checkout from a saved/current proposal inside Gift Catalog

modals.purpose: Keyboard-first saved-note picker and custom order-note composer with audience and optional date pushing.

vanillaUI.purpose: In-page charge/refund modal (rows, amount, run charge).
Edit order details (dates, totals, notes) and post to CRM.
Page scraping: emails, customer/order/message IDs, sales rep, page totals, charge rows, payment link, OOS items, page type, account conditions, brand-aware replacement scoring.
Resolves template {{variables}} against the live page + code-variable sandbox.
Content-script entry point: message router, mutation observers (preview button injection, Signifyd glow), global Ctrl+Q keybinding.

iframeUI.purpose: Quick-note save button + calendar button + sales-rep scanner; posts GB_OPEN_CALENDAR / GB_SALES_REP_FOUND; reports GB_DATES_PUSHED.
Executes the date-save ASP.NET postback chain (fetchCalendarState → postCalendarForm → submitCalendarUpdate) and reports step progress.
Posts order notes with retry logic.
Date parsing/formatting helpers for the postback chain.

actionsShelf.what: Persistent floating pill, bottom-right of every golfballs.com CRM page; expands into a context-aware vertical action list. Toggle with double-tap Shift. Actions register via actionRegistry; ordering: modal-contextual → page-contextual → general → danger.

actions.label: Run last query / Scan for recent orders
Only overdue + due today / Show all tasks

keyboardShortcuts.action: Select Nth filtered item / category chip
keyboardShortcuts.where: inside composer modals + EmailPreview categorize rail

pageDetection.how: detectPageType() in src/lib/pageContext.js (URL regex + DOM + page-engine schema), with smart-detection.js fallbacks and per-read overrides in the actions shelf; re-evaluated on MutationObserver events.

messageHandlers.note: Cross-context communication is message-driven; chrome.alarms schedules authenticated policy refreshes. There are no context menus or chrome.commands.

automations.name: Campaign Runner orchestration
automations.trigger: Run Campaign from a selected CRM Search or Task List result
automations.what: EmailRunner resolves each recipient, validates a configured sender, sends sequentially through the bounded worker transport, records last-sent timestamps, and exposes per-recipient retry/progress.

automations.name: Order date auto-push
automations.what: Multi-step ASP.NET postback chain via iframe with step toasts; pushes dates + note to the order.

automations.name: Catalog re-index
automations.what: Re-pulls full Solr index when older than giftCatalog.cacheHours.

automations.name: Watch list auto-cleanup
automations.what: Deletes completed items older than watchList.autoDeleteCompletedDays.

automations.name: Signifyd glow
automations.what: Re-applies fraud-score row glow as rows render.

automations.name: Theme live-update
automations.what: Rebuilds CSS custom properties in every frame instantly.

automations.name: CRM index capture
automations.what: Encrypts complete CRM rows in worker-owned IndexedDB while retaining names for ranked local search.

automations.name: Customer reply relay
automations.trigger: emailRelay.notifications enabled in the admin build
automations.what: Primes a cursor, maintains a 25-second authenticated long poll with a one-minute recovery alarm, stores/folds inbound reply notifications, updates the toolbar badge, and raises toasts on open golfballs.com tabs.

transports: Power Automate HTTPS trigger (primary, when enabled and configured)
mailto → Outlook (fallback: formatting stripped, no signature; bulk = one window per send)
emailPipeline.imageHandling: Inline converted to CID attachments (base64, max 3MB each) in background extractEmailImages(); requires matching Power Automate flow.
emailPipeline.signature: emailSignature HTML auto-appended on PA sends only.

templateVariables.resolvesTo: sandboxed JS expressions with read-only h.domText, h.fetchText, h.fetchJson, h.catalog, h.product, and h.parse helpers

workflows.name: First-time setup
steps: Open any golfballs.com CRM page (UI injects automatically)
Review feature toggles (all on by default except Power Automate)
Optionally preview a team settings URL and choose scopes to import
Optionally enable Power Automate + paste flow URL

workflows.name: Log a call + follow-up task
steps: On contact page open Call Log
Open Quick Task → set due (+1w) → submit

workflows.name: Run a bulk campaign
steps: CRM Search / Task List → select rows
Pick template / or build multi-step campaign in Campaign Manager
Run with pacing; monitor progress; pause/resume

workflows.name: Extract & verify a logo / submit proof
Set order dates
steps: Update Dates → watch step toasts → done

workflows.name: Share team configuration
steps: Create a named Shared Settings Template with selected scopes
Teammate previews URL and chooses scopes to import

uiLibrary.modalMounting: mountFloating(id, render) → host div[data-gb-scale=modals], render({ onClosed, bindClose }); re-call animates close
uiLibrary.editorRouting: editor.html sidebar .sb-tabs → activeTab state → src/pages/*.jsx renders into #editor; new views = new tab button + page component + sidebar switch case
uiLibrary.build: Vite per-entry IIFE bundles via build.js: src/content/*.jsx → react-dist/content/*.js; add manifest content_scripts entry (or load on extension page directly)
